title: Break a Palindrome
description: Change exactly one character of a palindrome string to make it lexicographically smallest and non-palindromic.
pseudocode:
1: if length is 1 return ""
2: for i from 0 to length/2 - 1:
3:   if s[i] != 'a':
4:     s[i] = 'a'
5:     return s
6: s[length - 1] = 'b'
7: return s

steps.note: Iterate through the first half of the string
Check if s[0] is not 'a'; it is 'a', continue loop
Check if s[1] is not 'a'; it is 'b', condition met
Return the new lexicographically smallest non-palindrome
